description: This file defines the StopWatch class within the Thunder::Core namespace, providing timing functionalities such as measuring elapsed time and resetting the stopwatch, utilizing the SystemInfo class for system-specific timing.

classes.name: StopWatch
classes.description: A class providing stopwatch functionalities to measure elapsed time and reset the timer, relying on SystemInfo for system-specific timing.

methods.name: StopWatch()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stopwatch with the current system ticks.

methods.name: Elapsed()
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time in ticks since the last measurement or reset.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch to the current system ticks and returns the elapsed time since the last reset.
